embeds.title: STFL LEAGUE LEDGER
embeds.description: Public league-level accounting for dues, league expenses, prizes and the Dynasty Pot.

fields.name: POSTED HERE
fields.value: Payment confirmations • Dues status • Future-season prepayments • Prize payouts • Dynasty Pot balance • The Season Ledger

fields.name: A PAYMENT COUNTS WHEN
fields.value: The Commissioner has confirmed it and recorded it here (Article III). A future 1st- or 2nd-round pick trade made before the required prepayment is confirmed here is reversed (Article XII).

fields.name: SEASON LEDGER
fields.value: Within 30 days after the STFL Championship concludes, the Commissioner posts dues received, prizes paid, operating reserve spending, the League Services Allocation and the Dynasty Pot balance.

fields.name: PRIVACY
fields.value: Do **not** post payment credentials, account numbers, login details or sensitive personal financial information.
